thread:
maya: quick async pulse for BlueCove private cutover tomorrow 09:00 PT — need a short status + any last-minute blockers. plan: 09:00 infra handoff, 09:15 canary, 10:00 ramp. who is owning certs / image push / smoke?
lee_neteng: neteng: firewall rules are staged but waiting on customer thumbprint for egress cert pinning (NET-452). also need them to whitelist outbound IPs listed below.
lee_neteng: IPs to whitelist: `35.199.12.34`, `34.120.45.66`, `18.205.33.12`
tonY_sre: tony_sre: s/s — can run the canary job once images are present and egress is allowed. I still need confirmation that the egress prober will return 200 for the three destinations.
rachel_platform: rachel_platform: platform side PRs: helm chart bump -> PR #682 (waiting review). image tag  `redwood/bluecove:2026-03-18-rc3` pushed to internal registry but not to the airgap mirror yet.
sam_pipeline: sam_pipeline: CI/ops: airgap signing flow completed, artifact is in staging-s3 `s3://bluecove-airgap/artifacts/2026-03-18-rc3.tar.gz`. need KMS key rotation window from customer or we can use fallback key (requires approval).
sam_pipeline: command to verify artifact checksum: `sha256sum 2026-03-18-rc3.tar.gz` -> `d4c3b2...`
lee_neteng: quick Q: customer asked if we need 443 egress or specific port range. we require 443 + 5222 for prober agent. tell them to allow both.
maya: noted — I'll confirm with the customer tonight re: ports + thumbprint. who is owner for rollback plan?
tonY_sre: tony_sre: I'm on rollback owner. rollback runbook: revert helm to v2026-03-18-rc2, kill canary svc, restore route to standby pool. I posted the runbook in the onboarding doc.
rachel_platform: rachel_platform: +1 to tony owning rollback. I'll cut a canary-only RBAC policy beforehand so we can isolate.
sam_pipeline: sam_pipeline: one blocker: image sync to the onsite mirror requires `mirror-agent` version >= 1.8.0. customer node shows 1.6.2. if they can't upgrade we can ship a local helper container to do a manual rsync.
lee_neteng: okay flagging that in NET-452. customer-side contact is @networking-team-customer (they confirmed upgrade may be delayed until next week).
maya: that's a hard blocker if they can't upgrade. can we do the manual rsync path? how long estimate?
sam_pipeline: sam_pipeline: manual rsync path estimated 30-45m with guided runbook. I'll prepare the steps now and post link.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled `bluecove-canary` job for 2026-03-19T09:15:00Z (canary window 15m). will hold if artifacts not confirmed by 08:45 PT.
maya: action list for cutover tomorrow (owners + ETA):
- neteng: confirm cert thumbprint + egress whitelist by 20:00 PT today (lee_neteng)
- platform: merge PR #682 + tag release to mirror by 08:30 PT (rachel_platform)
- ci/ops: publish airgap artifact and checksum to customer mirror by 08:45 PT (sam_pipeline)
- sre: standby rollback ready and tested by 08:50 PT (tony_sre)
- maya: customer signoff and final go/no-go at 08:55 PT
lee_neteng: I'll aim for 19:45 PT with the thumbprint confirmation. if customer delays, I'll escalate.
rachel_platform: I'm reviewing PR now, if I don't finish before 08:30 PT I'll ping for quick approval.
sam_pipeline: prepping manual rsync runbook here: https://internal.redwood/bluecove/runbooks/manual-image-sync — will DM the customer lead.
tonY_sre: I'll run a dry-run of the rollback steps in staging tonight at 22:00 PT and post the results.
maya: ok thanks. if anything looks like it will slip beyond the 08:45 artifact deadline, please call it out here so we can move the window. otherwise we'll proceed with scheduled canary. :thumbsup:
lee_neteng: fyi added NET-452 note about `mirror-agent` fallback.
maya: last Q for the thread — who will monitor logs during the canary? want two eyes: one infra and one app.
tonY_sre: sre will monitor infra logs + latency metrics.
rachel_platform: i'll monitor app errors + rollout events.
maya: perfect — thanks all. I'll post final cutoff and go/no-go at 08:55 PT.\n
